utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—what updates do you have for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're low on spare parts and a few tools—think you can help gather some from the neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can ask around. I've got a squeaky chair I'd love to bring in too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Uli, I've got the generator set up behind the old library for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I'm not sure I'll be able to come by, but I appreciate you letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No problem, Uli. If you change your mind, it's behind the old library.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's a community event where people fix broken items. Are you interested in coming?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I'd love to come! I have a broken lamp that could use some fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, it's on Saturday. We'll coordinate pickup from the school at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring your tools, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, is it today? I thought I had it down for Sunday...

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No, it's Saturday. Check your calendar again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? I'm bringing my old radio.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Ira, actually I just heard from Rosa that it got moved to Sunday! Still at the community center though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, really? I just checked with Quinn and she said Saturday. Are you sure Rosa had the right info?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? What about it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just checking if you need any tools or a hand with something for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nah, I think I'm good. Thanks though.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Rey, have you heard about the repair drive? I think I signed up but I can't remember the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it's a community event to help fix up people's homes. I'm hoping to get a set of screwdrivers from it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Screwdrivers? I don't recall anything about tools... Maybe I should check my notes again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Faye, I've got my tools ready for the repair drive this Saturday. We should sync up with the school pickup at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect timing! I'll meet you at the school gate right at 3, and we can head over together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Faye! I'll see you at the gate with my tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I really hope Gus remembers to bring a hammer—I don't want to get there and find we're missing tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good point, Pia. I'll shoot Gus a text to remind him, and we've got some spare tools at the center just in case.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief—thanks Rosa. I'll still pack my own screwdriver just in case.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, have you heard about the repair drive we're organizing? It's this Saturday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great! I was just asking around about it. I can bring my soldering iron and multimeter.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Sam! That's exactly the kind of expertise we need. I'll add you to the volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hello Kira, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You mean fixing up that old truck down the street? Are you serious?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh no, it's not just a truck—it's a community repair drive for small appliances and electronics. Could use your hands if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Hana! We're having a repair drive this Saturday. Want to come help out?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, Quinn! What time and where is it? And do I need to bring any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! It's at the corner of Elm and Pine, starting at 10 AM. Bring whatever tools you have, but we'll have some there too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sam, could you remind me again when and where the repair drive is happening? I want to make sure I have the right tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Hana! It's this Sunday at the community center, starting at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Sam! So Sunday at 10 AM at the community center. Is there anything specific I should bring tool-wise?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hello? Eli, did you hear me? Is the repair drive finished or not?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's still going on! We're meeting right after school pickup at the community center. You should come by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, good. Are they still working on lamps and stuff? I might bring my broken one.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive, but I can't make it this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, is it Saturday? I thought maybe it was Sunday... or was that something else?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it's definitely Saturday. Sorry, wish I could help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. Are you still able to come?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday at 10, right? I've got it in my phone... I think. Yes, I'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, see you then! Don't forget to bring any tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules! We're having a repair drive this Saturday. Want to join us and maybe bring some tools?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I'm already helping organize it! Can't wait to see everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's fantastic, Jules! I knew I could count on you. Anything special you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Dane! Did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday? It's still at the community center from 10 to 4!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh good to know, I'll be there. Thanks for the reminder, Tess!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great! I'll see you there. Do you have anything you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, but did Gus remember to bring a hammer? I hope he didn't forget.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll text Gus to remind him.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh good, thanks for texting him. I just know how these things slip our minds.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got the generator set up and ready. What time should we start on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure, but I'm ready whenever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: How about we start at 9 AM and plan to wrap up before the school pickup at 3?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Vik, I've been hearing about this repair drive from everyone. Can you tell me more about it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. Everyone's talking about it!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, Saturday works for me! Should I just bring my broken things, or is there anything else I need to know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, great to see you! Just a heads up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center — hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, Sunday? I had Saturday marked in my calendar. Let me adjust my schedule. Thanks for letting me know, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You're welcome, Eli! I'm glad you can adjust. Let me know if you need any more details about Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'm bringing my old radio. Can you come too?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You're really bringing a radio? You think they can fix that old thing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey, if anyone can fix it, it's this crew! Want to come see?
